mostWorthwhile.text: Building the inner ear's sensing tissue was most worthwhile: the bending hairs helped explain how movement changes nerve signals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the finished ear to the body felt less engaging because it was the only offered combination and the open ends made it predictable.

surprise.text: I hadn't known how the fluid's movement reached the nerves; the picture showed it bending tiny hairs on hearing cells.

arbitrary.text: None felt arbitrary. The pictures gave each connection a purpose, although the menu showed which combinations were compatible.

continue.text: I might continue if another chapter connects a familiar sense to how the body works. This one made the route understandable, though the final assembly was predictable.
